results.name: 51 reference questions retain stable source columns and eight operational groups
Empty, zero, unavailable and not-applicable answers remain distinct
Currency, decimal hours, Boolean polarity and contextual answers keep their types
Inconsistent equipment and guard answers are blocked at submission
Conditional child drafts are preserved, never counted while inapplicable
Applicable replacement cannot be marked N/A; impossible action dates fail
Branch aggregation uses integer minor units, adverse counts and context counts
New cycles reject duplicate branch-months and preserve old metric snapshots
Reference source titles and input values are escaped in return HTML
The standalone route and every KRI section render through the complete module chain
Missing and outside-scope return IDs do not silently substitute a branch
